subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on July 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB1234 Departure: JFK International Airport Arrival: London Heathrow Airport Please ensure you arrive at least 2 hours before your flight. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
